title: DINA BAMA PATIL LIBRARY & STUDY ROOM
summary: A website for books, events, and a community around them.
story: A freelance library website built with a React frontend and FastAPI / MongoDB backend, with admin-managed books, events, and content.
context: A library needed a website it could maintain.
process: The application connects a public React interface to an API and an admin-managed content collection.
result: Built and delivered to a paying client.

title: Flinkoo
summary: An AI-powered finance data platform exploring Indian mutual funds through past-performance data.
story: Flinkoo was an LLM-powered finance data platform built by a three-person team in February 2025. It explored suggestions for Indian mutual funds based on their past performance.
context: The idea was to connect financial data with an LLM workflow that could suggest mutual funds using historical performance.
process: I worked on the backend and the connections between the platform's components. The stack included Python, Flask, cron jobs, MongoDB, REST APIs, LLM tool calls, and a React frontend. My teammates handled the mathematical work and frontend.
result: The team worked on the platform in February 2025. The project was later abandoned.
role: Backend development and integrations. The mathematical work and frontend were handled by the other members of our three-person team.

title: Search Slash
summary: Type slash commands in Google Search and expand them into advanced search operators instantly.
story: Search Slash is a Chrome extension that brings slash commands to Google Search. Commands expand inline into advanced search operators.
context: Advanced search operators are useful, but their syntax can be easy to forget. Slash commands offer a shorter way to compose a search.
process: The extension turns slash commands typed in Google Search into advanced search operators, keeping the interaction inside the search field.
result: The extension's source code is available in the linked GitHub repository.
